intro: Bilbao rewards visitors who wander between the Guggenheim, the old town, and the green hills above. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro Bilbao is clean and fast; single tickets cost about €1.70-1.95 by zone.
The green Euskotren tram runs along the river past the Guggenheim; single ticket €1.50.
Bilbobus city buses are red with a flat fare; Bizkaibus green buses serve the province.
A Barik card costs €3 and saves money on metro, bus, tram and local trains.
Taxis are easy to find; ride apps like Uber and Bolt operate in Bilbao.
Driving is hard: hilly one-ways, works, and a low emissions zone. Walk or cycle instead.

guggenheim.name: Guggenheim Museum Bilbao
guggenheim.price_text: ≈ EUR 18 adult · under 18 free · check current price
guggenheim.hours: Tue–Sun roughly 10:00–19:00 · closed Monday · check on the day
guggenheim.tip: Book a timed ticket online and go early; the titanium building is best seen from the river side at sunset.

fine-arts.name: Bilbao Fine Arts Museum
fine-arts.price_text: ≈ EUR 10 adult · free on some days · check on the day
fine-arts.hours: Tue–Sun roughly 10:00–20:00 · closed Monday · check on the day
fine-arts.tip: A calm, uncrowded museum with Basque and Spanish masters; a good rainy-day plan near the Guggenheim.

casco-viejo.name: Casco Viejo, Bilbao
casco-viejo.hours: Always open · bars busiest late evening
casco-viejo.tip: Wander the seven streets (Siete Calles) and stop for pintxos; the cathedral and Plaza Nueva are good anchors.

san-mames.name: San Mames
san-mames.price_text: Stadium tour and match tickets vary · check on the day
san-mames.hours: Tours and matches only · check the schedule
san-mames.tip: Athletic Club's home ground; book a stadium tour or a match ticket well ahead if you are a football fan.

ribera-market.name: Mercado de la Ribera
ribera-market.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item
ribera-market.hours: Roughly Mon–Sat mornings to early afternoon · check on the day
ribera-market.tip: Bilbao's big riverside market; go in the morning for fresh produce and pintxos at the stalls.

artxanda.name: Artxanda viewpoint (Funicular de Artxanda)
artxanda.price_text: ≈ EUR 4–5 return funicular · check on the day
artxanda.hours: Funicular roughly daily, long hours · check on the day
artxanda.tip: Ride the old funicular up for the best wide view over the city; go near sunset.

gran-via.name: Gran Vía and Plaza Moyúa walk
gran-via.tip: Stroll Bilbao's grand shopping avenue from the Guggenheim to Plaza Moyúa for architecture and people-watching.

pintxos-tour.name: Pintxos crawl in Casco Viejo
pintxos-tour.price_text: ≈ EUR 35–60 guided, or pay per pintxo self-guided
pintxos-tour.tip: Pintxos are small bites eaten standing at the bar; keep your toothpicks, they are often counted for the bill.

azkuna.name: Azkuna Zentroa (Alhóndiga)
azkuna.hours: Roughly daily, long hours · check on the day
azkuna.tip: A converted wine warehouse with 43 quirky columns; free to look around and a good coffee stop.

zubizuri.name: Zubizuri footbridge and river walk
zubizuri.tip: The white arched bridge links the Guggenheim area to the old town side; walk the Nervión riverbank at dusk.

gaztelugatxe.name: San Juan de Gaztelugatxe day trip
gaztelugatxe.price_text: ≈ EUR 20–40 bus/tour · free to visit the site, parking may cost
gaztelugatxe.hours: Site roughly daily daylight hours · check on the day
gaztelugatxe.tip: A dramatic stone stairway to a hermitage on the coast; free entry but you may need to book a time slot in peak season.

arriaga.name: Teatro Arriaga
arriaga.price_text: Ticket prices vary by show · check on the day
arriaga.hours: Box office and show times vary
arriaga.tip: Bilbao's main theatre by the river; check the programme for opera, dance or concerts during your stay.

bilbao-la-vieja.name: Bilbao La Vieja street art walk
bilbao-la-vieja.hours: Always open · busier and safer-feeling by day
bilbao-la-vieja.tip: The old industrial quarter across the river has murals and small galleries; explore by day and keep to main streets at night.

puente-colgante.name: Puente Colgante (Vizcaya Bridge)
puente-colgante.price_text: ≈ EUR 10 walkway ticket · ferry crossing cheaper · check on the day
puente-colgante.hours: Roughly daily · check on the day
puente-colgante.tip: A UNESCO-listed transporter bridge downstream; you can ride the gondola across or walk the high walkway.

mercado-indautxu.name: Indautxu food bars and market area
mercado-indautxu.price_text: Pay per item · pintxos roughly EUR 2–4 each
mercado-indautxu.hours: Bars roughly midday–late · check on the day
mercado-indautxu.tip: A local neighbourhood for pintxos away from the tourist crush; try the txakoli (light Basque white wine).

deusto-riverside.name: Deusto riverside walk
deusto-riverside.tip: Walk the Nervión path toward the university and the Guggenheim for a quieter view of the city.

bizkaia-bridge-tour.name: Bilbao river boat tour
bizkaia-bridge-tour.tip: A short boat trip on the Nervión shows the old industrial river and the modern city from the water.

catedral-santiago.name: Catedral de Santiago
catedral-santiago.price_text: Free to enter · small fee for cloister · check on the day
catedral-santiago.hours: Roughly daily, limited hours · check on the day
catedral-santiago.tip: The Gothic cathedral at the heart of the old town; step inside for a quiet moment between pintxos bars.

doa-casilda.name: Parque de Doña Casilda
doa-casilda.tip: Shady park next to the Fine Arts Museum; good for a picnic or a break between museums.

stays.why: Old-town lanes, pintxos bars and the cathedral on your doorstep; metro and tram nearby.
Central and handy: main train station, shops and a short walk to the Guggenheim.
Quiet, local feel with good restaurants; between the old town and the museum district.
University area across the river; cheaper rooms and a short metro or tram ride to the centre.

food: Eat pintxos standing at the bar: small plates on bread, €2–4 each. Point at what you want and keep your toothpicks for the bill.
The Mercado de la Ribera by the river is a good stop for fresh produce and casual bites; check opening days on the day.
Try bacalao (salt cod) dishes and txakoli, the local slightly sparkling white wine.
Lunch is the main meal; many restaurants offer a menú del día around €12–18 on weekdays.
Dinner starts late, often after 20:30. Bars are busiest Thursday to Saturday.
more_time: Take the Artxanda funicular for a hilltop view over the city; a short ride and cheap ticket.
Day trip to the coast: train to Mundaka or Bermeo for fishing villages and the coast.
Swap a museum afternoon for the Bizkaia Bridge (Puente Colgante) in Getxo, a UNESCO site, by metro.
